description: Format and print the last login log.

option.name: --before
tip: Print only lastlog records older than DAYS.

option.name: --clear
tip: Clear the lastlog record of a user.
Can be used only together with --user.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.

option.name: --set
tip: Set the lastlog record of a user to the current time.
Can be used only together with --user.

option.name: --time
tip: Print the lastlog records more recent than DAYS.

option.name: --user
tip: Print the lastlog record of the specified user(s).
A login name, a numerical user ID, or a UID range may be given.

option.name: -a
tip: Print the records of users that have logged in at least once.
